cells.docstring: Opens and identifies the given image file. Returns an Image object.

inputs.name: image_path
inputs.description: Path to the target image file on disk.

preconditions.description: Image file path must exist.

cells.docstring: Creates a new blank RGB image with the given dimensions and solid color fill.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Image size specified as a (width, height) tuple.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Color fill tuple (R, G, B) or color name string.

preconditions.description: Size must be a 2-tuple of positive integers.

cells.docstring: Creates a new blank RGBA image with alpha transparency support.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: RGBA color tuple (R, G, B, A). Defaults to fully transparent.

preconditions.description: Size must contain 2 elements.

cells.docstring: Creates a new blank 8-bit grayscale ('L' mode) image.

preconditions.description: Size must be 2D.

cells.docstring: Converts an image of any supported mode to 3-channel RGB color space.

inputs.description: Input Pillow image in any convertible mode.

preconditions.description: Input mode differs from RGB.

cells.docstring: Converts an image to RGBA format, adding an opaque alpha channel if none exists.

outputs.name: output_var
outputs.description: Converted RGBA image with active alpha channel.

cells.docstring: Converts an image to 8-bit single-channel grayscale ('L') via standard ITU-R 601-2 luma transform.

cells.docstring: Converts image to 1-bit bilevel black and white ('1' mode) using dithering.

inputs.description: Input image to convert to bilevel bitmap.

preconditions.description: Input must be RGB.

cells.docstring: Bridge: Exports a Pillow RGB Image to a NumPy ndarray preserving standard RGB channel order.

outputs.name: output_var
outputs.description: 3-channel uint8 numpy array in RGB order.

preconditions.description: Image must strictly be in RGB mode.

postconditions.description: Output is 3D array with 3 color channels.

cells.docstring: Bridge: Exports a Pillow RGB Image to a NumPy ndarray reversing channels to BGR order (for OpenCV interoperability).

outputs.name: output_var
outputs.description: 3-channel uint8 numpy array in BGR order.

preconditions.description: Image must strictly be in RGB mode.

postconditions.description: Array has 3 channels in BGR sequence.

cells.docstring: Bridge: Exports a Pillow grayscale ('L') Image to a single-channel 8-bit intensity NumPy array.

outputs.name: output_var
outputs.description: 2D uint8 numpy array representing gray intensity.

preconditions.description: Image must strictly be in 'L' mode.

cells.docstring: Bridge: Ingests a 2D intensity NumPy array into a Pillow grayscale ('L') Image.

preconditions.description: Input array must be 2D single channel.

cells.docstring: Resizes image to target dimensions using high-quality Lanczos resampling.

Crops a rectangular region from this image specified by a 4-tuple (left, upper, right, lower).

cells.docstring: Rotates image counter-clockwise by the specified angle in degrees.

inputs.name: expand
inputs.description: If true, expands the output image size to hold entire rotated content.

Flips the image vertically (top to bottom mirror).
Rotates image 90 degrees counter-clockwise without resampling artifacts.
Applies Gaussian blur convolution filter with adjustable radius.

inputs.description: Standard deviation / kernel radius of the Gaussian filter.

preconditions.description: Radius must be non-negative.

cells.docstring: Applies Box blur filter where each pixel is set to the average value of its surrounding box.

inputs.description: Radius of the box filter window.

cells.docstring: Applies a predefined edge-finding kernel highlighting boundaries within the image.
Applies a predefined contour filter extracting outline boundaries.

inputs.description: Minimum brightness difference threshold to trigger sharpening.

cells.docstring: Applies a median filter for salt-and-pepper noise reduction.

inputs.name: size_val
inputs.description: Kernel size (must be an odd integer).

preconditions.description: Kernel size must be odd.

inputs.description: Contrast multiplier. 1.0 gives original, 0.0 gives flat solid gray.

preconditions.description: Enhancement factor must be non-negative.

inputs.name: factor
inputs.description: Brightness multiplier. 0.0 gives black, 1.0 is unchanged.

preconditions.description: Factor must be non-negative.

cells.docstring: Adjusts color saturation balance using ImageEnhance.Color.

inputs.name: factor
inputs.description: Saturation multiplier. 0.0 gives black and white, 1.0 is original.

preconditions.description: Color enhancement requires RGB mode.

cells.docstring: Adjusts sharpness continuously using ImageEnhance.Sharpness.

inputs.name: factor
inputs.description: Sharpness factor. 0.0 gives blurred, 1.0 is original, 2.0+ is sharpened.
